generation.explanation: Set the two cost formulas equal: 20 + 0.10x = 35 + 0.05x. Subtracting gives 0.05x = 15, so x = 300 minutes — at that point both plans cost exactly $50. Below 300 minutes Plan A is cheaper (lower flat fee); above 300 minutes Plan B wins (lower per-minute rate). Drag the Minutes slider to compare the plans at any usage level and watch the dots meet at the break-even point.
